# The GLITCH
## A cursed Minecraft mod

This mod brings you to the alternative dimension: you'll first need to go in a cave to find a `Glitched Stone` block (it generates in big veins). Once mined, it will drop a `Glitched Stone Shard`. Smelt it to obtain a `Glitched Stone Piece`. Craft 4 of them to get a `Packaged Glitched Stone Pieces`. Place it down and right-click it with a `Glitched Stone Piece` to light it. Then, once right-clicked, you'll find yourself in an alternate dimension where all the world are plains, ready to build. You'll be happy, untill you'll understand that the only way back is the death.
